scope: Source and Skill update; public summary of two existing-input regressions. No project drawings or raw runtime logs are included.

implementation.dimensionsAndAxes: Copy and adapt native objects from the approved template; verify actual references and preserve measurements.
implementation.A28: Single bend with the diagonal joining the circle is connected to the shared axis layout.
implementation.axisReplacement: Verify a candidate before retiring the original. On failure retain the original and roll back unaccepted candidates.
implementation.axisRollbackValidation: The adopted final probe verified both retirement orders, preservation of original native groups after rejected candidates, save/reopen and normal host exit. Earlier failed attempts remain recorded; exhaustive failure-path coverage is not claimed.
implementation.finalReadback: Read the final saved DWG independently; bind rule, module, drawing and actual-print evidence. Generator verified flags alone are insufficient.
implementation.wallHeight: Unified per-wall normalization and independent final reopen, with bounded local repair and recorded exceptions.
implementation.paperSettings: Saved layouts and actual printing use shared paper settings; compare effective settings and inspect actual PDFs.

knownExceptions: Three linked annotation objects retain nonconforming typography because no verified safe independent edit was applied.
Eight title-block text items exceed the paper boundary; eight additional title-block internal text overlaps remain in one case.

One opening label overlaps an elevation label in the other case. It is also present in an earlier print from the same input; its first introduction is unknown and local avoidance was not attempted in the read-only review.
Expected axis-end completeness is unknown in one case; existing-object verification does not prove source completeness.
Some protected or unreadable instance domains remain outside complete annotation coverage. Furniture is preserved; unknown coverage is not counted as a pass.
Two layouts have no identified title-block text leaves, so title-block coverage is unresolved rather than passed.
Some specialist probes failed during test dispatch, object access or process shutdown. Their reports remain failed and are not substituted for normal final-project evidence.
qualityStatus.publicationPolicy: P06 permits delivery with a same-version exceptions list; processing completion, compatibility and successful PDF generation do not imply all rules passed.
